evidence.why: The callback invokes COPY_ATTRS with the Master Hand attribute type.
Exact macro definitions distinguish initial storage activation from attribute refresh.

facts.rationale: The canonical COPY_ATTRS macro performs a typed assignment through the existing destination pointer. Its behavior differs from PUSH_ATTRS, which explicitly assigns the active pointer.
facts.value: Obtains the Fighter from the supplied HSD_GObj and copies a complete ftMasterHand_SpecialAttrs block from fp->ft_data->ext_attr into the storage already referenced by fp->dat_attrs. This callback does not reassign dat_attrs or select backup storage; initial copying into dat_attrs_backup and activation of that storage occur through PUSH_ATTRS in ftMh_Init_OnLoad.
